note: State beach on the Silver Strand between Coronado and Imperial Beach. Back-in RV sites in paved rows along the ocean-side lots, west of Highway 75, with the open Pacific beach a short walk across the sand; San Diego Bay's beaches are across the highway. Showers are cold. --Claude
summary: parks.ca.gov page + brochure/map and ReserveCalifornia API read. $65 E/W, $85 premium; 50 A + water, no sewer, dump; 113 sites in two sections, RVs to 40 ft, self-contained only, 14-night max, year-round. Bayfront -> coastal walk (pads 60-90 m from the high-tide line across the public beach). Re-pin west of SR-75.
